changes.text: Added short names for materials - you can now give any material a short name in Settings → Fabrics (e.g. "Neraki" instead of "Neraki Waterproof Canvas FR (Water Repellant)")
The short name is used automatically when filing and printing, preventing the "path too long" issues Windows can throw on materials with very long names
Short names are optional - leave the field blank and the full material name is used as before
Reports, labels and the material list still show the full material name; only the behind-the-scenes file paths get shortened
Batch History now opens much faster - it loads your most recent days right away instead of the entire print history, so the screen is ready almost instantly even with months of batches behind you
Search now covers your whole history, including by order number - type an order number, file name, or material and find it anywhere in the history, not just in recent days
Recent days show instantly; when searching further back, older days load automatically in the background (briefly showing "Searching older days…"), with matches appearing as they come in
Fixed: a batch that has just been rolled back, or a day that has been opened, no longer disappears from search results

Cotton workstation now leaves files at the Heat Press stage after scanning, instead of advancing straight to QC - matching the polyester flow. Files show as "Awaiting QC" at the QC station until they are picked up

Scanning a batch barcode at the QC workstation now moves that batch's Heat Press files into QC in one step (the cotton roll heat press has no scanner, so QC completes this step). Per-file actions via select and right-click still work as before
Holds are now shared across all workstations - when one operator puts a file on hold, everyone sees it immediately with no more holds that only appear on the PC that set them

Rollback now returns every file to its correct folder - when a batch mixes files from different groups, rolling it back (whole batch or a single file) sends each file back to its own original folder instead of lumping them all together

Scanning a batch at the QC workstation no longer opens a popup window with a file list - you now see all batch files directly on the production screen and decide what to do with them yourself by selecting files with the mouse and right-clicking

The context menu shows only the actions that make sense for all currently selected files - Pass, Receive from sewing, Send to Sewing, Go back, or Rollback to inbox - and you can select multiple files at once and perform an action on all of them simultaneously
Files that haven't physically arrived at the QC station yet are visible on screen as dimmed with an "Awaiting QC" label, so you can move only the files you have in hand while the rest wait

Reprint and Override badges are now shown separately - a file returned from Production shows a Reprint badge, while the Override badge only appears when an operator has deliberately changed the print quantity
Both badges are shown at the same time when a reprint quantity has also been manually overridden, so the full picture is always visible
Overriding a quantity on a reprint file no longer requires clearing the reprint first - just set the new value directly
Batch totals in Batch History now reflect the quantity actually printed (including partial reprints and overrides), not the original quantity from the filename
The Reprint badge in Production disappears automatically once the job reaches the Packed stage
Fixed: the quantity field in the Rollback modal could not be cleared and retyped using the keyboard
Added partial reprint support - when rolling back a file from Production you can now set how much needs reprinting (metres for linear, piece count otherwise) along with the reason
Files awaiting a reprint now show a persistent Reprint badge in the inbox and batch history until the reprint is fulfilled
Reprint quantities flow automatically into the print job and batch info on resubmit - no manual re-entry
Reprint requests are cleared automatically once a file reaches the Packed stage
Analytics waste figures now reflect partial reprint quantities for more accurate per-fabric reporting
Redesigned the production UI with an updated layout and visual improvements
Added multiple selection support for rollback reason buttons in Analytics
Reorganised the production view into logical groups for better clarity
Added event listeners to detect missing updates and handle them gracefully
Improved Analytics UI layout and readability
First production release
